R01.note: No cold storage, stone crocks, crunchy with a sharp bite: preserved in brine.

R02.note: Dropping the loaf cost cake and coffee sales; it was essential, not expendable.

R03.note: Fires had been sustaining the grasses that cedars later crowded out.

R04.note: Cause forgotten but the hostility persisted across generations; heritage too vague.

R05.note: Partial restriction meant to reduce the habit, not destroy or condemn it.

R06.note: Hires drawn from three schools and staff referrals: insider circle, not merit selectivity.

R07.note: Rule mixed starters and substitutes on the bus; aim was team bonding.

R08.note: Outbound lanes jammed, inbound empty: mass departure.

R09.note: Bareness came from the architect's conviction, not from thrift.

R10.note: Calm reports contradict the starving, deserting army; belie means misrepresent.

R11.note: Accepted the evidence yet refused to perform it; trial run on prisoners.

R12.note: Made things worse than before, not merely failed.

R13.note: Doctors picked likely recoverers: selection bias arithmetic cannot fix.

R14.note: Concession: understandable ignorance, yet kept cooking after warnings, so not blameless.

R15.note: Attentive and warm, then ideas vanish; disengaged ruled out by her attentiveness.

R16.note: All weight passed through the bolt: most critical part despite its price.

R17.note: Supply so scarce they recycled it from urine; worked but not obtainable.

R18.note: Mayor minimized the loss citing other openings; union objected to the word.

R19.note: Crooked and patched yet survived earthquakes: not flimsy.

R20.note: Confidence presumed rather than earned, resting on novelty; awarded is a near miss.

R21.note: Dense gelatin stock, three spoonfuls make a meal: heavy.

R22.note: Weavers idle waiting for yarn: spinning was the constraint.

R23.note: Non-anonymous survey hid dissatisfaction shown in exit interviews.

R24.note: Acts honestly without preaching; espouses is the lecturing contrast.

R25.note: Opinions split sharply along party lines.

R26.note: Still clear nights, fires and fans before dawn protect blossoms from frost.

R27.note: Most votes but under half: a plurality, not a mandate.

R28.note: Floor plan outsells everything and guards carry copies: visitors get lost.

R29.note: Short span, enormously tall piers, steep path: a deep gorge.

R30.note: Votes counted by heads not acres: most people.

R31.note: Not tired by hours; upset by corrections and dates set without her.

R32.note: Errors real but conviction stood: none was decisive to the outcome.

R33.note: Too-polished advocacy made jurors suspicious; glib fits slick smoothness.

R34.note: Self-initiated scouting binder shows shrewdness, not just composure.

R35.note: Sound sustains and blurs quick notes: highly reverberant hall.

R36.note: Partner waited for better offers: business shrewdness; not daring or speed.

R37.note: Applied exact wording even when disliking result: faithfulness to the law.

R38.note: Breakdowns, guide quitting, night in rain: a disaster remembered fondly.

R39.note: Shaken viewers; case count dropped when possible: purpose was to reassure.

R40.note: Same dozen symphonies approved: the programmed pieces unchanged.

R41.note: Each change forced by external events, not a plan.

R42.note: Climbed all day, thin air, yet flat land: high flat plain.

R43.note: No grudge, warm words, but no real contact: drifted apart, not embittered.

R44.note: Not refuted but ignored for decades: buried.

R45.note: Destroyed orchards, half the growers sold land.

R46.note: Signing their own names changed behavior; nothing new taught rules out apprised.

R47.note: Narrator mocked the prudent neighbor; the foolishness was the narrator's.

R48.note: Coach's question taught them to attack their own arguments first.

R49.note: Opening complaints made it seem harshly negative; actually admiring.

R50.note: No title yet coach and rookies follow her: informal influence.

R51.note: Staging overshadowed the score; only disproportionate takes 'to' idiomatically here.

R52.note: Lasting revulsion to the dish despite knowing the food was blameless.

R53.note: Bloom to the horizon, every frame alike: abundant.

R54.note: Picked early, never gather sugar: look good but not ripe.

R55.note: Dismissive unconcern about a habit that never inconvenienced them.

R56.note: Inherited longer legs in decades: rapid evolution; expand is the head-count near miss.

R57.note: A square per generation's first child: a record of lineage.

R58.note: Fourteen of twenty-five stranded leaves too few members present.

R60.note: Bench renaming, $40 refund, paper clips: trivial sums.

R61.note: Thin white crust on wooden lath painted as stone.

R62.note: Account books show scribes kept working; the claimed elimination is disputed.

R63.note: Predicted short-lived yet never replaced over three generations: enduring.

R64.note: Four minutes of orchestral music before the first scene.

R65.note: Admitted figures, then minimized them by comparisons and distraction.

R66.note: Tunes exaggerated and mocked: lullaby on trumpets, hymn on kazoo.

R67.note: Per-student share fell by a third: insufficient for school size.
